description: Dependency Engine v0 — sectional (multi-workfront) SS+lag rule table. Default templates carry FS-only trade links; when a project is sectional (large area / several workfronts) the listed trade pairs are re-linked as Start-to-Start with a deterministic lag so trades flow zone by zone instead of waiting for the whole floor. Small projects keep the template FS logic untouched. Edit rules here only (single source); never hard-code pairs in Python.

activation.note: auto: sectional when area >= sectional_area_sqm_min OR derived/explicit workfronts >= min_workfronts. workfronts = clamp(floor(area / workfront_area_sqm), 1, max_workfronts) unless --workfronts is given. on/off force the decision.

lag_policy.unit: successor calendar workdays (construction 7-day for site trades)
lag_policy.note: Takt reading: the successor trade may start in zone 1 once the predecessor trade has cleared roughly one zone (predecessor duration ÷ number of zones).

gate_policy.note: Inspection gates (隐蔽工程验收) between the two trades are kept as Finish-to-Finish so the successor trade cannot complete before its gate inspection completes. This keeps the gate on the network (no dangling logic) while allowing zone-by-zone overlap.

scope.note: Only leaf site tasks with duration > 0 are matched; summaries and milestones are never re-linked.

rules.label_zh: 隔墙骨架 → 二次机电支管 (分区穿插)
gate_keywords: 隔墙及主管管线隐蔽工程验收
rules.rationale: Branch conduits / pipework follow partition framing zone by zone; on a single-zone floor they wait for the in-wall inspection (FS).

rules.label_zh: 大机电主管 → 二次机电支管 (分区穿插)
gate_keywords: 隔墙及主管管线隐蔽工程验收
rules.rationale: Branch runs tee off the mains; once mains in zone 1 are up the 2nd-fix crew can follow.

rules.label_zh: 大机电主管 → 墙面封板与天花吊顶龙骨 (分区穿插)
rules.label_en: MEP mains → wall boarding & ceiling grid (sectional overlap)
gate_keywords: 隔墙及主管管线隐蔽工程验收
rules.rationale: Ceiling grid hangers go in once high-level mains in that zone are fixed.

rules.label_zh: 隔墙骨架 → 墙面封板与天花吊顶龙骨 (分区穿插)
rules.label_en: Partition frame → wall boarding & ceiling grid (sectional overlap)
gate_keywords: 隔墙及主管管线隐蔽工程验收
rules.rationale: Wall boarding follows framing zone by zone.

rules.label_zh: 二次机电支管 → 天花封板与饰面 (分区穿插)
rules.label_en: MEP 2nd fix → ceiling board close & finishes (sectional overlap)
rules.rationale: Ceiling is closed zone by zone after the above-ceiling 2nd fix in that zone is inspected.
